@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+"""`lamina export`: print information about a config file."""
+
+try:
+    import platformdirs  # noqa: F401
+except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
+    platformdirs = None
+
+import sys
+
+from lamina.parser import parse
+
+
+def cmd_export(argv: list[str], *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Run the export command; return the exit code."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append("--")
+    if len(argv) != 1:
+        print("usage: lamina export FILE", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    with open(argv[0], encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        source_text = fh.read()
+    doc = parse(source_text, source=argv[0])
+    for section in doc.sections():
+        print(f"{section.name}: {len(section.entries())}")
+    return 0

+from lamina.cli.export import cmd_export
+
+
+def test_export_counts(write, capsys):
+    path = write("c_export.conf", "[a]\nx = 1\ny = 2\n")
+    assert cmd_export([path]) == 0
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "a: 2"
+
+
+def test_export_usage():
+    assert cmd_export([]) == 2
